from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CourtDocument(BaseModel):
    """Represents the key attributes of a single court document required to determine if it matches the target cause of action."""
    title: str | None = Field(description="The full title or name of the court document")
    cause_of_action: str | None = Field(description="The specific cause of action (案由) explicitly stated or derived from the document content")
    case_category: str | None = Field(description="The broad legal category of the case, e.g., Administrative, Civil, Criminal")
    procedure_type: str | None = Field(description="The procedural nature, e.g., Trial, Execution, Review, Supervision")
    grounding_quote: str = Field(description="A short verbatim excerpt from the document supporting the extracted attributes")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Container for extracted data from a single court document."""
    documents: list[CourtDocument]
